references.text: Bet-Araba is also mentioned as a city in the territory of the tribe of Benjamin, indicating the border areas between Judah and Benjamin
Bet-Araba is mentioned as a boundary marker for Judah, confirming the location of this city in the wilderness region
The Araba area is mentioned in connection with the border between the tribes, showing the geographical context with the desert cities
The wilderness (midbar) is used as an image of Israel's journey and God's care for His people in desolate areas
